label: Bible Study
prompt: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the _____ that is on the sea shore.
verse: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
note: Solomon's wisdom, measured in beach sand — the same image God used for Abraham's descendants.

label: Warm-Up Word
note: Two words, one standing order: Rejoice evermore — no expiration date on the joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a _____, and girded himself.
verse: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
note: The King of kings rose from supper, laid aside his garments, and picked up a servant's towel.

label: Deep Water
prompt: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the _____ of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
verse: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
note: At the second temple's foundation, the young shouted for joy while old men who'd seen Solomon's temple wept.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he shall restore the lamb _____, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
verse: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
note: David judged Nathan's story of the stolen lamb: restore it 'fourfold.' Nathan's reply: 'Thou art the man.'
